title: agenticweb.nl — Dutch open data
description: Dutch vehicle, address, building, elevation, holiday and demographics data, paid per call.
summary: Dutch vehicle, address, building, elevation, holiday and demographics data, paid per call.
offersHint: Dutch vehicle, address, building, elevation, holiday and demographics data, paid per call. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://api.agenticweb.nl/api/mcp

toolsPreview.name: catalog
toolsPreview.description: Free: list every data tool/endpoint with price, params and a free HTTP sample URL.

toolsPreview.name: sample
toolsPreview.description: Free: get the documented demo response for any paid tool, so you can see the exact response shape before paying. Returns fixed sample data, not a live lookup.

toolsPreview.name: nl_vehicle
toolsPreview.description: Dutch vehicle lookup — $0.02 per call (x402, USDC on Base). Registration, fuel/EV, APK (roadworthiness) and open recalls (terugroepacties) for a Dutch licence plate (kenteken).

toolsPreview.name: nl_school_holidays
toolsPreview.description: Dutch school holidays — $0.008 per call (x402, USDC on Base). Current, merged Dutch school-holiday dates, queryable by school year, region or a specific date.

toolsPreview.name: nl_vacation_region
toolsPreview.description: Vacation region resolver — $0.01 per call (x402, USDC on Base). Resolve a Dutch place to its vacation region (noord/midden/zuid) and attach that region's current holiday dates.

toolsPreview.name: nl_address
toolsPreview.description: Dutch address lookup — $0.005 per call (x402, USDC on Base). Resolve a Dutch postcode + house number to a full address (street, city, gemeente, province, WGS84 + RD coordinates), or reverse-geocode coordinates to the nearest address.

toolsPreview.name: nl_building
toolsPreview.description: Dutch building lookup (BAG) — $0.008 per call (x402, USDC on Base). Construction year (bouwjaar), floor area (oppervlakte), use function (gebruiksdoel) and status for a Dutch address, from the BAG via PDOK.

toolsPreview.name: nl_elevation
toolsPreview.description: Dutch elevation (AHN / NAP height) — $0.006 per call (x402, USDC on Base). Ground height above NAP, surface height and derived object height for a Dutch postcode or coordinate, from the AHN 0.5 m height model via PDOK.

toolsPreview.name: nl_validate
toolsPreview.description: Dutch identifier validation — $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base). Offline validation of a Dutch identifier: BSN (elfproef), IBAN (structure + mod-97 + bank), or kenteken (sidecode format).

toolsPreview.name: nl_demographics
toolsPreview.description: Dutch municipality demographics — $0.005 per call (x402, USDC on Base). CBS key figures for a Dutch municipality (population, men/women, households, average household size, population density), by gemeente name or CBS code.

toolsPreview.name: global_fx
toolsPreview.description: FX conversion (ECB) — $0.003 per call (x402, USDC on Base). Currency conversion using ECB euro reference rates. Informational only — not tradeable quotes.
